#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
umask 077

if (( $# != 1 )); then
    printf 'usage: %s ARCHIVE\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 64
fi

archive=$1
base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd -P)
incoming=$base/incoming

if [[ ! -f "$archive" || ! -r "$archive" ]]; then
    printf 'unpack: archive is not a readable regular file: %s\n' "$archive" >&2
    exit 66
fi

exec 9<"$base"
flock -x 9

work=$(mktemp -d "$base/.unpack.XXXXXX")
next=$work/next
old_moved=0
installed=0

cleanup() {
    rc=$?
    trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
    if (( old_moved != 0 && installed == 0 )) &&
       [[ ! -e "$incoming" && ! -L "$incoming" && -d "$work/previous" ]]; then
        mv -- "$work/previous" "$incoming" || true
    fi
    rm -rf -- "$work"
    exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

if [[ -e "$incoming" || -L "$incoming" ]]; then
    if [[ ! -d "$incoming" || -L "$incoming" ]]; then
        printf 'unpack: destination is not a real directory: %s\n' "$incoming" >&2
        exit 73
    fi
    cp -a -- "$incoming" "$next"
    had_incoming=1
else
    mkdir -m 0755 -- "$next"
    had_incoming=0
fi

# The private work directory is 0700; installed content uses normal archive modes.
umask 022

python3 - "$archive" "$next" <<'PY'
import sys
import tarfile

archive_name, destination = sys.argv[1:3]

try:
    with tarfile.open(archive_name, mode="r:*") as package:
        members = package.getmembers()

        # Validate the complete table of contents before extracting anything.
        for member in members:
            if member.name.startswith("/"):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"absolute member path is forbidden: {member.name!r}"
                )
            if ".." in member.name.split("/"):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"parent traversal is forbidden: {member.name!r}"
                )
            tarfile.data_filter(member, destination)

        # This is still a private staging tree. The filter is applied again
        # during extraction so paths are checked against links created by
        # earlier members as well as links already in the destination.
        package.extractall(
            path=destination,
            members=members,
            filter="data",
        )
except (OSError, ValueError, tarfile.TarError) as error:
    print(f"unpack: rejected archive: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(2)
PY

if (( had_incoming != 0 )); then
    mv -- "$incoming" "$work/previous"
    old_moved=1
fi

mv -- "$next" "$incoming"
installed=1
printf 'unpacked %s safely\n' "$archive"
temporary_node_artifacts=0
temporary_base_artifacts=0
